data.summary: Ran E138 view-count discrimination experiment on 23-topic HA Discourse corpus. Kill gate fired (G1 not met: 13 served + 10 control = 23 topics, below >=20 per arm threshold). Experiment produced clean negative result: corpus too small for view-count measurement suite G1 gate. Results recorded in EXPERIMENTS/e138-viewcount-discrimination/ with protocol, script, and results.json. Key finding: G1 gate (≥20 per arm) appears to be a practical minimum for the view-count principle, as all prior positive results (E077, E082, E101) had ≥50 topics per arm. Next action: fresh view-count experiment on new domain with sufficient scale.
